apps/api/src/lonora_api/__init__.py.name: Server package
apps/api/src/lonora_api/__init__.py.description: Marks the server code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/app.py.name: Server assembly
apps/api/src/lonora_api/app.py.description: Builds the server: wires in the request guards, the sign-in and feature requests, the app-link and Android download addresses, and serves the web app for every other address.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/chart_renderer.p.name: Chart renderer
apps/api/src/lonora_api/chart_renderer.p.description: Serves the separate mini-app and its files that draw the trading charts.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/cli/__init__.py.name: Command-line package
apps/api/src/lonora_api/cli/__init__.py.description: Marks the code behind the `lonora` command as one package; holds no logic of its own.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/cli/app.py.name: Command-line entry
apps/api/src/lonora_api/cli/app.py.description: The one way the `lonora` command reaches Lonora: it checks the caller's pass, then runs the named command (prices, candles, a snapshot, a notification, a wake) for the agent it belongs to, refusing anything that names no agent.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/device_metadata..name: App link details
apps/api/src/lonora_api/device_metadata..description: Serves the public details that let the iOS and Android apps claim their links, never trusting anything the caller sends to decide who is who.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/env.py.name: Server settings
apps/api/src/lonora_api/env.py.description: Reads the server's settings from its environment and hands them to the rest of the server.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/errors.py.name: Error handling
apps/api/src/lonora_api/errors.py.description: Turns errors into clean, consistent replies for the apps.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/health.py.name: Health & readiness
apps/api/src/lonora_api/health.py.description: Answers whether the server is alive and whether it's ready to serve, checking the database and the worker's heartbeat; a missing phone never fails it. It also keeps checking in the background that the worker runs, and tells the owner when it has stopped.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/http_body.py.name: Upload size limit
apps/api/src/lonora_api/http_body.py.description: Caps how large a request body can be before it is read, so oversized uploads are refused early.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/pdf_layers.py.name: PDF reading
apps/api/src/lonora_api/pdf_layers.py.description: Pulls out what an agent can read from an uploaded PDF — its text, or an image of a scanned page — in a separate process that is killed if it takes too long.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/runtime.py.name: Shared server state
apps/api/src/lonora_api/runtime.py.description: Holds the shared pieces every request uses — chiefly the database connection — created once when the server starts.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/server.py.name: Server startup
apps/api/src/lonora_api/server.py.description: Starts the server: it ensures the owner account exists, then serves the apps on a host and port and the `lonora` command on a local socket, in one process.

GET /.well-known/assetlinks.json.name: Android app link proof
GET /.well-known/assetlinks.json.description: Serves the details that let the Android app open Lonora's links directly.

GET /.well-known/apple-app-site-associat.name: Apple app link proof
GET /.well-known/apple-app-site-associat.description: Serves the details that let the iOS app open Lonora's links directly.

GET /download/lonora.apk.name: Download Android app
GET /download/lonora.apk.description: Serves the Android app file for download, refusing it if the file is missing or not a real app package.

HEAD /download/lonora.apk.name: Check Android app download
HEAD /download/lonora.apk.description: Reports whether the Android app file is available to download, without sending it.

GET /{path:path}.name: Serve the web app
GET /{path:path}.description: Serves the web app's files for any address that isn't a server request, falling back to the main page so the app can route it.

GET /charts/render.name: Open chart renderer
GET /charts/render.description: Serves the small mini-app page that draws the trading charts.

GET /chart-runtime/{path:path}.name: Chart renderer files
GET /chart-runtime/{path:path}.description: Serves the files the chart mini-app needs.

GET /charting_library/{path:path}.name: Charting library files
GET /charting_library/{path:path}.description: Serves the files of the bundled charting library the charts are built on.

POST /v1/{command}.name: Run a command
POST /v1/{command}.description: Runs one `lonora` command for the agent whose pass is presented, and refuses when no agent is named, reading and sending nothing.

GET /api/health.name: Is the server alive
GET /api/health.description: Reports the server is OK, failing if the database can't be reached.

GET /api/ready.name: Is the server ready
GET /api/ready.description: Reports the server is ready only when the database is reachable and the worker's heartbeat is fresh; a phone not being set up is reported, not failed.
